items.t: Virgin Galactic (SPCE) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Flight Delay Drives Analyst Target Cuts
items.sum: The analyst fair value estimate for Virgin Galactic Holdings has shifted from US$3.55 to US$3.01, indicating a more cautious stated upside case. Research teams link these lower price targets to the delayed first commercial spaceflight to early Q2 2027, the updated timeline for the Apeiron service, and questions around funding needs during the extended pre revenue period.
